timeFormat.description:
The time, as a Qt format string (Qt.formatDateTime): HH / H hour 0-23, hh / h hour 1-12 (add AP for AM / PM),
mm minutes, ss seconds. Default "HH:mm".

Takes a text. Default: "HH:mm".

dateFormat.description:
The date, as a Qt format string: d / dd day, ddd / dddd weekday (short / full), M / MM / MMM / MMMM month
(number / short / full name), yy / yyyy year. Default "dddd d MMMM".

Takes a text. Default: "dddd d MMMM".
